svg.text: NI channels used by pybehaviour / behaviour_control_v2, drawn from the rig file (rigs/SV-07-054.yaml). Device names (Dev1, Dev2…) must match NI MAX.
Lick input, valve, triggers, camera clock
Optogenetics: laser and galvo mirrors · not enabled on this rig
piezo signal split to both boards (T connector)
trial start trigger to every board
Output to a device (arrow: direction of the signal)
Cable between boards or back into the log (dot = branch)
not in the old BehaviorSetupConnectic diagram
board only on rigs with that option
* Card models as on the SV-07 rigs (6221, 6343); other rigs may differ. Rename devices in NI MAX or edit the rig file.
Not set in software, drawn as wired in the lab (check on each rig): the piezo split to both boards, the digital outputs
looped back to the logged inputs (context, PdCO), the trial start trigger to the opto board, the laser command copy to AI16.
Unused camera exposure inputs: tie to AI GND. Coil calibration: connect the teslameter instead of the PdCO ch1 copy. Outputs can also be copied to the ephys NI board.
Regenerate after changing the rig file: uv run python -m pybehaviour.wiring rigs/SV-07-054.yaml
